Definition: Lo-Ruchamah, the symbolic name of a daughter of Hosea
BiblicalUsage: Lo-ruhamah means 'no mercy' — the symbolic name God gave to Hosea's daughter. In Hosea 1:6, "Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel"; and in Hosea 1:8, "and bare a son.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lo-ruhamah is the name of a mercy withheld — I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel — and the mercy that returns, because Hosea's God does not leave His people in that name forever.
